snippet.title: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit - OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit is OUT NOW on PC & consoles!

In Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit, players become Spirit Scouts on a haunted island, befriending and assisting an unusual assortment of troubled ghostly bears. As they wander the island’s forest each day, they’ll find hidden secrets and help soothe the local ghost population, while being able to send gifts to their online friends via an asynchronous multiplayer feature.

The sequel offers new bears to befriend, a new island to explore, new seasonal events, collections, a new powerwashing activity and other surprises.

Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/cozygrove

+ Play now on all the following platforms!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021960/Cozy_Grove_Camp_Spirit/
Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cozy-grove-camp-spirit-switch/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cozy-grove-camp-spirit/9PFC35HJKN69
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019291
